name: Cangkul
description: Cangkul is a popular Indonesian card game where players try to get rid of all their cards by following suit. The name 'Cangkul' means 'to dig with a hoe' in Indonesian, referring to digging through the stock pile for playable cards. Similar games include Burro (Spain) and Donkey (Goa).

history.origins: Indonesia. Cangkul ('to dig with a hoe'): shedding game; 3â€“5p, 52 cards, 7 each. Follow suit; can't follow = draw from stock until playable; stock empty = pass and pick up trick. Similar to Burro in Spain and Donkey in Goa.
timeline: Traditional origins: Played for generations in Indonesia
Modern Era: Remains one of the most popular Indonesian card games
Related games: Spanish Burro and Goan Donkey share similar mechanics
Rules codified in written form and shared in English with input from regional players
history.cultural: The name reflects Indonesian agricultural heritage - the cangkul is a traditional farming tool. The game is played casually in homes and coffee shops.
history.evolution: The core game has remained stable. Some variants add jokers as wild cards that win tricks.

setup.deck: 52 cards (A high). Optional joker as wild in some variants.
setup.dealing: 7 cards each; remainder is face-down stock. Clockwise.

rules.objective: Be the first player to play all your cards. Winner is first to empty their hand.
rules.gameplay: The player to dealer's left leads any card. Other players must follow suit if possible. The highest card of the led suit wins the trick, and the winner leads to the next trick. If a player cannot follow suit, they must draw cards from the stock one at a time until finding a card of the required suit, which must be played immediately. If the stock is empty and a player cannot follow, they don't play to that trick and must pick up all cards from the incomplete trick at the end, adding them to their hand.
keyRules: Highest card of led suit wins trick
Winner of trick leads to next trick
If cannot follow suit, draw from stock until finding playable card
If stock empty and cannot follow, pass and pick up trick cards
Optional joker wins any trick it's played to

strategy.basic: Try to maintain cards in multiple suits. Play high cards to win tricks when you have strength in a suit. When leading with the stock low, consider leading suits where opponents may be forced to pass.
strategy.intermediate: Pay attention to which suits opponents are drawing for. If you win a trick and the stock is low, leading a suit where you saw someone drawing can force them to pass and take cards.
strategy.advanced: Card counting to track which high cards remain. Strategic use of the joker if playing with one. Managing hand size - sometimes it's better to pass and take cards if you can then control play.
tips: Keep variety in your hand - don't play all cards of one suit
Winning tricks lets you control the lead
Watch for opponents who have to draw frequently
When stock is low, be careful about playing your last card of a suit
If you have the joker, save it for when you need to win a crucial trick
Sometimes taking cards can give you control of the endgame

scoring.winCondition: Win by being first to play all your cards.
